name: Osananajimi to Juu Nen, Natsu
source:
Three summer vacations separated by several years of development.
Young friends become young lovers.

Nostalgic, romantic and passionate ADV. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE101066.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
三段暑假，相隔數年，兩人的關係也在這些日子裡悄悄改變。
年輕的朋友成為年輕的戀人。

懷舊、浪漫、熱情的ADV。

［來自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE101066.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
